# A facts-first Docker dashboard

Dopsy v0.1.2 adds a read-only starting point for Docker investigations. The
overview shows current container facts without contacting a model provider;
the diagnostic chat still starts only when you submit a question.

## Highlights

- A bounded live overview with four status numbers, current CPU columns, a
  running/not-running ring, and individual container cards.
- Critical and warning signals are calculated from Docker facts, not invented
  by the model. Missing metrics and partial collection are made visible.
- A shorter German interface with restrained forest-green styling and a
  separate diagnostic workspace.
- Snapshot charts are labelled as current readings. Dopsy does not yet store
  historical metrics or draw trend lines.

## Try this version

```bash
git clone --depth 1 --branch v0.1.2 https://github.com/smn-pascal/dopsy.git
cd dopsy
cp .env.example .env
# Set DOPSY_DEMO_MODE=true in .env
docker compose up --build -d
```

Open `http://localhost:8080`. The recommended setup stays bound to localhost.
Dopsy has no authentication yet; do not expose it directly to the internet.
See the [getting-started guide](https://smn-pascal.github.io/dopsy/guide/getting-started)
and [dashboard guide](https://smn-pascal.github.io/dopsy/guide/dashboard).
